An early-game specialist that boosts other Operators in range and can see into others' sightlines when upgraded.|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Operator''', internally referred to as '''EvolvedOperator''', is the [[Tower Evolution|evolved]] version of the [[Scout]], unlocked by reaching Level 20 on the [[Scout]] tower, either by getting the experience or by skipping the need to get it by paying {{Robux|499}}. Once done, it can be bought for {{Gem|4,500}} and {{Coins|15,000}}. As it is an evolved tower, only some of its upgrades are unlocked at the start. All other have to be unlocked by reaching higher [[Tower Evolution|evolution levels]] on the tower. The '''Operator''' fires in bursts, with a moderate delay between each one. Starting from Level 2, it gains a [[Coordination]] damage buff for each '''Operator''' that has [[Coordination]] unlocked placed to it in a small radius. At Level 5, it gains [[Shared Optics]], which lets it attack enemies in the range of another '''Operator''' with [[Shared Optics]] that is in its range. If the '''Operator''' in its range has other '''Operators''' in their range, then it will be able to fire from these '''Operator''' ranges too. The '''Operator''' has hidden detection from Level 1 and flying detection from Level 2. }} ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:PirateOperator0.png|175px]] |- !Skin ||{{Colour|Pirate}} |- !Rarity |{{Colour|Uncommon}} |- !Daily Store Cost |{{Coins|4,000}} |- !Obtained From |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Operator''' is best used in the early to mid-game. *At Level 2, it gains [[Coordination]], which makes it apply and receive a damage boost from other nearby '''Operators''' that have [[Coordination]]. **The area in which it is applied is very small, meaning the tower has to be placed in a tight group for this to work well. *At Level 5, it gains [[Shared Optics]], which will make it target enemies in the range of other '''Operators''' with [[Shared Optics]] in its range. **This slightly conflicts with its [[Coordination]], as that requires '''Operators''' to be placed close to each other while [[Shared Optics]] benefits from them being spread out. ***One way to benefit from both is to have one main group of '''Operators''' where one of them can see an '''Operator''' that is at the edge of their range, extending all their ranges. Afterwards, another '''Operator''' can be put in the range of the one at the edge, extending it even further. This can be repeated until you hit the placement limit. ***Another method is to have a few groups of '''Operators''' placed together apart from each other, but close enough that one group has another group in its range. ==Trivia== *The '''Operator''' is one of the first three evolved towers revealed in 2020 prior to the release of the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the other two being [[Juggernaut]] and [[Kingpin]]. *The '''Operator's''' Level 3 design and upgrade name may be a reference to [[wp:RoboCop|Robocop]]. *The '''Operator's''' Level 6 upgrade name, ''1000-THR E.M'' is a reference to the name of the [[w:c:ultrakill:Earthmover|1000-THR Earthmover]] from ''ULTRAKILL'' **The Level 6 mask design is also possibly based on it. *The '''Operator's''' Level 4 upgrade name, ''Threat Detection Sentinel'', can be abbreviated to ''TDS'', which happens to be the abbreviation for Tower Defense Simulator. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''19 June 2026''' -
